استعملوا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْمَلُوا (istaʕmalū) /is.taʕ.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اُسْتُعْمِلُوا (ustuʕmilū) /us.tuʕ.mi.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
# اِسْتَعْمِلُوا (istaʕmilū) /is.taʕ.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْمَلَ (istaʕmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
